parsed.faithful: husband's giving them to the wife, at or before marriage; but they are paraphernal only in regard to that husband who gave them as such, and are esteemed common movables, if the wife, whose parapherna they were, be afterwards married to a second husband; unless he fail in the same manner appropriate them to her.
